rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only recovery student needs independent TRAIN cells with natural and both induced recovery directions before whole-cell validation.
observable_information: Four-frame pixels and inherited pixel-driver action at teacher intervention, plus TRAIN-only privileged teacher steer as label; cell and arm are partition metadata.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Collect and hash TRAIN-only unpulsed, left-pulse and right-pulse recovery labels; no eligible runtime student or submission candidate yet.
expected_success_endpoint: All 72 episodes valid; >=20 independent recovery cells, >=20 per-direction pulse-to-opposite-teacher cells, >=4 natural control recovery cells and zero invalid actions.
control: Exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49 as inherited driver in all arms; unpulsed natural arm per cell.
falsifier: Missing/invalid data or file hash, invalid action, too few independent recovery cells, either directional transition coverage below 20 cells or fewer than four unpulsed recovery cells.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Fresh TRAIN tracks 1-3 x seeds 5170-5177, three teacher-only arms per cell, 72 episodes with hashed pixel/teacher labels.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local collection capped at 3,600 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
